title: Department of Unclaimed Tomorrows
logline: A weary mail carrier delivers receipts for futures that have not happened yet, sometimes centuries too soon.

character.name: intentionally unresolved
character.desire: deliver the undeliverable without lying about the future
character.conflict: uncertain outcomes and a bureaucracy built for certainty
character.consequence: ordinary people notice an option they hadn't imagined
character.unresolved: who wrote the earliest receipts, and what happens when a letter is refused?

setting.name: Window 0
setting.description: An office with no settled calendar for undated, unclaimed possibilities.

crossing_rules: A fictional dispatch is not a factual forecast.
A saved draft is not a pledge, proof, or publication.
No real person's story is imported without permission.
AI and community adapters require explicit export/consent and separate ownership review.
